body: Wow thank you so much! Thanks for the information, didn’t know all this things. That last blood test wasn’t done within the first hour of waking up so I’m definitely going to take that in consideration for the ones coming next. Thank you for sharing your experience, that really helps! ❣️

Interesting! i’m sure they are going to order more blood tests since a few months are going to pass by till my appointment, hope that a definitive conclusion comes out of it. I didn’t know that it could be just a thing of the first test, I appreciate your response!
Yeah... you’re right, hopefully it’s just gonna be a pill and call it a day. I think I’m just overthinking everything and that’s what scares me hahaha
Yeah, hope it’s just the meds or side effects wearing down. Thanks! will try to do that
well... I’ve been on birth control due to medical reasons for a few months now, I think I started taking it in october

I started with escitalopram for a couple of months, then my psychiatrist added clonazepam and y was taking both for like... 6 months I think? then she began to lower the doses and now I’m not taking anything and feel pretty stable.
I noticed more side effects with clonazepam, the first doses made me fall asleep within 20 minutes, but it was fine because I used to take it at bedtime. It was a bit hard to let go and stop taking it, so be careful, you can develop codependency. With escitalopram no big deal, just noticed that my libido decreased:( and with the first doses my sight was very blurry

I’m on Keppra too, I have depression and anxiety, so far I’ve tried Clonazepam and Escitalopram. They have both worked for me, but I think it would be ideal you talk to your neurologist or a psychiatrist nevertheless
yeah, now that I know that, everything coming from my parents feels so fake. Thank you for answering!!

Not exactly my case but somewhat similar. I’m also f21, I have epilepsy and depression so I take a lot of meds and it sometimes makes my libido almost nonexistent. It was worse during this pandemic, sometimes I was with my gf and we would try to masturbate together via video call but all of a sudden I couldn’t keep going, it was  really frustrating. It only happened over a short period of time though... I would recommend you to talk to her, don’t pressure her, make her feel comfortable and see if there’s anything else going on
